rules.selection: max in-sample t-stat among configs with >= min trades and avg >= target (costs C1)
rules.pass: OOS (C1): trades >= min, avg >= target, profit factor > 1

C0.name: C0 brief: spread 0.40 + commission + slippage, no financing

C1.name: C1 base: C0 + overnight financing (long T-bill + 0.5%, short 1.5% - T-bill)

C2.name: C2 harsh: spread 0.50, slippage 0.25, commission 0.05; long T-bill + 2%, short 3% - T-bill

C3.name: C3 measured: the bid/ask quoted in each fill's hour + C1's slippage, commission and financing
